name: claude-pane-submit
goal: Tracker messages typed into an idle Claude pane are submitted, not left as an unsent draft

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Live 26 Nov: cos composer held '[Pasted text #N +1 lines]'. Reproduced with a disposable real Claude pane: the old combined send-keys text+Enter left a 929-char message unsent. Expected: idle Claude pane submits it.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Gap: tmux fixtures treated any send as submitted and only modelled Codex drafts. New shared test/support/claudePaneFixture.ts models paste, coalesced Enter, split pastes and quiet footers; digest fixture now needs a separate Enter.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: loop record --phase red failed as expected at the test-only commit.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: submitClaudeTrackerDraft.ts: separate Enter once the draft shows, re-send after 5 s, never submits other text. Codex path unchanged.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: loop record --phase green passed with the unchanged test at the fix commit.

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
